sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: `/cdstub/browse`: the duplicate-row fix from the previous release could leak a skipped duplicate's "Added N years ago..." text onto an unrelated, earlier row's Title cell (via unbounded appendChild), instead of dropping it along with the duplicate row it belonged to — on a real fetch, one row accumulated over 44,000 characters this way, making its column render artificially wide.
